execution.implementation: Genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation plus five CID-exact oral reference drugs with deterministic local molecular descriptors and explicit threshold counts

observations: Exact PubChem structures and source properties are retained for five orally administered kinase-inhibitor reference drugs.
All five have zero Lipinski and zero Veber-style threshold exceedances under the retained definitions.
Local RDKit descriptors span molecular weights 393.44-499.62, MolLogP 3.33-4.59, TPSA 68.74-87.55 A^2, and QED 0.311-0.626.
A genuine mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open call returned the retained ready response for this case-specific context.
interpretation: The broad descriptor range among five oral reference drugs illustrates that simple thresholds are filters and do not supply a clinical ranking or exposure model.
limitations: The comparison omits salt form, solid state, formulation, dissolution, permeability, transporters, metabolism, dose, and exposure.
QED and all listed descriptors are computed molecule-level quantities.
Threshold exceedances do not rank efficacy, safety, developability, or probability of oral success.
The Rosalind operation opened only the task chooser; no Rosalind scientific job or laboratory experiment was executed.

provenance.note: The launcher observation records the exact Rosalind chooser response and does not represent scientific execution. CID-exact public records feed a deterministic local descriptor script with explicit Lipinski and Veber-style thresholds.

reproduction: Run python showcases/rosalind-workbench/cases/rosalind-oral-candidates/scripts/analyze.py from the repository root.
Invoke mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open with task_context five oral-drug property-profile teaching case, then compare the response with outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json.
Inspect the exact input records, comparison table, threshold definitions, summary, and SVG preview.
